comparison.objective: Move a rain gauge clear of a wall and orient an instrument-screen door north.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object placement using obstacle-distance and compass reasoning, not fine tool manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge earns 0.5 when sufficiently clear and north-facing screen earns 0.5; exact modeled tolerances beyond the twice-obstacle-height rule are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests standards-based spatial siting and orientation, not physical separation and containment.
